from.place: Classical constructibility input: relative Mayer--Vietoris reduction, via Stacks Tags 0GL0, 0GKN and 0GKK. Natural extension-by-zero short exact sequences for a two-open etale cover

title: Natural extension-by-zero short exact sequences for a two-open etale cover
statement: Let Λ be any commutative ring and X a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. For opens U,V of X with U ∪ V = X set W = U ∩ V. For T = U,V,W let jT:T→X be the inclusion and E(T)=jT* ⋙ jT!, where jT* is inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and jT! is extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] on sheaves of Λ-modules. There exist natural transformations iU:E(W)→E(U) and iV:E(W)→E(V) such that for every sheaf F the signed pair (iU(F),−iV(F)), followed by the pair of adjunction counits (εU(F),εV(F)), has composite zero and gives a short exact sequence 0→E(W)(F)→E(U)(F)⊕E(V)(F)→F→0 [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence].

proof.text: Use the generic categorical construction SheafOfModules.nestedMate from WeilConjectures.Algebra.Homology.OpenCoverMateComplexShortExact, imported with import all because these helpers are private. It transposes the restriction of the outer unit, conjugated by the restriction-composition isomorphism, giving a natural transformation. Apply the existing SheafOfModules.nestedMate_app and SheafOfModules.nestedTranspose_counit to identify its composite with the outer counit with the intersection counit. These helpers quantify over arbitrary categories, functors and adjunctions, so specialize directly to small etale sheaves. The signed pair therefore has composite zero.

At a geometric point in both opens, all three counits are isomorphisms. The two equal-composite identities identify the sequence with diagonal difference followed by addition, with explicit retraction and section. At a point in precisely one open, the intersection and the other-open stalk vanish, and the remaining counit is invertible. The covering excludes all other points. Transport along the stalk functor biproduct comparison. The exact conservative family of geometric stalk functors reflects short exactness.

theorem exists_natural_shortExact_openCover_lowerShriek
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let E (T : X.Opens) := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) T.ι ⋙
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) T.ι
    ∃ (iU : E (U ⊓ V) ⟶ E U) (iV : E (U ⊓ V) ⟶ E V),
      ∀ F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ),
      ∃ hz : biprod.lift (iU.app F) (-(iV.app F)) ≫
          biprod.desc
            ((openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
              U.ι).counit.app F)
            ((openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
              V.ι).counit.app F) = 0,
        (ShortComplex.mk (biprod.lift (iU.app F) (-(iV.app F)))
          (biprod.desc
            ((openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
              U.ι).counit.app F)
            ((openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
              V.ι).counit.app F)) hz).ShortExact
